items.q: Does the KOL library support genre-level filtering?
items.a: Yes — RPG, card, casual, competitive, and more. Filter by gameplay style, art style, and target region.

items.q: How does AI matching score creator fit?
items.a: We combine semantic analysis of your brief with a creator's historical collaboration data via aigcgateway. Every recommendation comes with a fit score and a per-criterion explanation.

items.q: Do DKIM/SPF settings require an engineer?
items.a: No. Our guided setup deploys compliant DNS records in under 3 minutes, no DevOps needed.
Email opens and statuses are real-time. Plays and engagement metrics update T+1. Audience profiles refresh weekly.

items.q: What does the trial account include?
items.a: Full access to all six modules — real data filtering, AI matching, template sending, and analytics.
